comments.text: In fact, here in the state of Rio Grande do Norte, where I live, there is a rather curious road: along a certain stretch, due to the slope and the lay of the land, if you stop your car, turn off the engine, and release the handbrake, it begins to roll backward—creating the striking impression that it is moving uphill on its own and defying gravity.
